senses.gloss: m. (פתק to cut, divide off; Var. lect. v. infra) the store-room in the dwelling house out of which the daily portions of provision and work are distributed; also the retailer’s shelves &c., contrad. to אוצר ware-house.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 2:7">Ab. Zar. II, 7</cite> (<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 39b:13">39ᵇ</cite>) <he>הבאין מן הה׳</he> the preserved locusts which the merchant takes from the shelves, contrad. to <he>מן הסלולה</he>, those laid out in baskets in front of the counter.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 40b:7">Ab. Zar. 40ᵇ</cite> <he>מן הה׳ מן האוצר ומן הספינה</he> (not <he>הסלולה</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 5); <cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 4:12">Tosef. ib. IV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 5:12">V</cite>), 12 <he>מן הפתק וכ׳</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <cite ref="E00773"><he>הפתיק</he></cite>, cmp. <cite ref="E00636"><he>הֶמְסֵס</he></cite> for fusion of article) from the shelves, the ware-room or the ship.—

<cite ref="Shabbat 50a:4">Sabb. 50ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 3:19">Tosef. ib. III</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 4:19">IV</cite>), 19 <he>גיזי צמר של ה׳</he> cut wool stored in the pantry (intended for spinning; Rashi: from the merchant’s shelves). [Ar. s. v. <he>אפתק</he> reads: <cite ref="A00819"><he>אוּפְתֵּק</he></cite>, noting a Var. <he>ה׳</he>. One Ms. Ar., a. Mish. ed. Nap. read <cite ref="A02648"><he>אפותיק</he></cite> for <cite ref="A00819"><he>אוּפְתֵּיק</he></cite>, induced by phonetic resemblance to ἀποθήκη. V. Ar. ed. Koh. s. v. <he>אפתק</he>, a. Rabb. D. S. to <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 39b">Ab. Zar. 39ᵇ</cite> note 8.]
